name: cs-fix-spot-id-case-uat
description: Post-migration fixes 2 and 3 (knowledge-base/post-migration-fixes.md): set the spot ids in currency_spot_mapping_table.spot and product_master_table.curr_mult_factor to the exact spelling used in underlying_settle_value_table ('SPOT BGN' -> 'Spot BGN'). The reload brought the MySQL spelling back; PostgreSQL matches case exactly, so the client statement refresh found no FX rate and printed BRL and other non-USD amounts as USD (ACM CRD 06-Nov). Proven by cs-05-root-cause-check-cfs: 8 mapping spots and 18 product spellings (36 products). After apply: refresh the client statement cache for 06-Nov and regenerate.

steps.where: tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = DATE '2026-11-06' AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(currency_spot_mapping_table.spot) AND u.underlying_id <> currency_spot_mapping_table.spot)

set.spot: (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = DATE '2026-11-06' AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(currency_spot_mapping_table.spot))

preconditions.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT lower(underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND value_date = DATE '2026-11-06' GROUP BY lower(underlying_id) HAVING count(DISTINCT underlying_id) > 1) x
preconditions.reason: the price table has one spelling per spot id, so the target spelling is unambiguous

steps.where: curr_mult_factor IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = DATE '2026-11-06' AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(product_master_table.curr_mult_factor) AND u.underlying_id <> product_master_table.curr_mult_factor)

set.curr_mult_factor: (SELECT min(u.underlying_id) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = '227cd5f5-4498-4dba-bda9-05b8edc41113' AND u.value_date = DATE '2026-11-06' AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(product_master_table.curr_mult_factor))
